ideas.pitch: A lightweight onboard computer vision pipeline for drone navigation through complex obstacle course hoops including diagonal split and hanging circles.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Obstacle Course Challenge - navigating semicircular, quarter, diagonal split rectangular, and freely hanging circular hoops.
ideas.title: HoopFlow Vision: Monocular Autonomous Hooping for SARC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core time-based scoring criteria of the obstacle course by replacing manual pilot latency with automated high-speed hoop detection.

ideas.pitch: A custom 3D-printed payload mounting cradle with dynamic ballast compensation to maintain stable hover and 90-degree turns while carrying 50g.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 0: Preliminary Submission - stable flight while carrying a 50 g payload and executing a precise 90 degree turn.
ideas.title: PayloadGuard 50g: Precision Balance and Drop System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the strict Round 0 evaluation metric for weight management and payload stability during aggressive maneuvers.

ideas.pitch: A rapid mobile and desktop telemetry tuning utility designed to adjust stability and PID gains dynamically between obstacle course trial runs.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Obstacle Course Challenge - maintaining stable, low-altitude flight through sharp 90 degree turns and T-rod obstacles.
ideas.title: AeroTuner: Real-time PID Tuning App for SARC Drones
ideas.why_it_could_win: Saves critical competition time by letting teams calibrate flight stability in seconds without rewriting onboard firmware.

ideas.pitch: An independent hardware safety override and telemetry logger that guarantees safe landing protocol execution at the designated landing point.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 0 and Round 1: Safe landing at the designated point and safety mechanisms documentation.
ideas.title: SafeLanding Telemetry & Emergency Cutoff Box
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges prioritize safety compliance; an independent fail-safe hardware cutoff prevents disqualification and protects expensive drone builds.

ideas.pitch: A simulation environment using physics-based modeling to pre-calculate optimal trajectory paths for crossover and split semicircular hoops.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Obstacle Course Challenge - completing the obstacle sequence and crossing the finish line based on time bonuses.
ideas.title: SARC Sim-to-Real Obstacle Trajectory Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a distinct competitive advantage in time-based scoring by optimizing flight paths before touching the physical course.
